summary: SEO/social-metadata verification for TapPresence PREVIEW. Verified static index.html OG/Twitter tags (all point to https://tappresence.com/social-share.png with width=1734, height=907, image/png, twitter card=summary_large_image). Verified runtime head tags via document.head evaluation on all 14 marketing routes — every route PASSED all checks (unique title, canonical=https://tappresence.com<path>, exactly one <h1>, og:type present, og:site_name=TapPresence, og:image ends /social-share.png, og:image:width=1734, og:image:height=907, twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:image ends /social-share.png, valid JSON-LD present). Homepage JSON-LD contains Organization (name=TapPresence, url=https://tappresence.com, logo=https://tappresence.com/logo512.png, sameAs=[LinkedIn, Instagram]) + WebSite + SoftwareApplication. SEO landing pages have BreadcrumbList + SoftwareApplication + FAQPage (where applicable). Invalid profile slug /xyz-invalid-profile-slug-404zz renders 'Profile not found' state AND head has <meta name=robots data-seo content='noindex, follow'>. Static assets (/social-share.png, /favicon.png, /logo512.png, /manifest.json, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt) all return 200 with correct content-types. sitemap.xml uses https://tappresence.com and lists all 14 marketing routes + industries + register + login + 4 legal pages with no private routes. robots.txt disallows /admin /dashboard /leads /meetings /settings /billing /nfc /referral and references https://tappresence.com/sitemap.xml. Functional regression: /, /pricing (PricingSection renders with Starter/Pro/Business plans), /login (email+password form), /register (form) all render; /dashboard and /leads correctly redirect unauthenticated users to /login. No console errors on /, /pricing, /digital-business-card. Valid public profile check skipped — no known published slug available; acceptable per task.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO implementation is clean and complete. useSeo() correctly emits complete OG/Twitter set with production canonical origin (https://tappresence.com) as intended.
Homepage Organization JSON-LD uses logo=/logo512.png (correct, distinct from social image).
Invalid PublicProfile route correctly applies noindex,follow with data-seo attribute — good SEO hygiene.
Optional/nice-to-have: sitemap.xml lastmod dates are static 2026-08-15 — consider dynamic generation eventually, but not a bug for this task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All SEO Phase 1+2 checks pass on preview. Route-level head-tag validation harness used page.evaluate() reading document.head. If retesting, use the 14 marketing routes list from the request. Valid published-profile slug check was not performed (no known slug); if needed, log in and publish a card to test og:type=profile + ProfilePage JSON-LD + no noindex meta.
